# TourBox Tech

> > TourBox Tech provides creative controller hardware and software solutions for designers, photographers, and video editors working with Adobe Creative Suite, DaVinci Resolve, and other professional creative applications.

TourBox Tech manufactures customizable hardware controllers that streamline workflows for creative professionals. The site offers product information, software downloads, tutorials for popular creative applications, and educational content on design fundamentals and color theory.

## Key Topics

- TourBox Elite
- TourBox Console Software
- DaVinci Resolve
- Adobe Photoshop
- Adobe Illustrator
- Adobe InDesign
- Color grading workflow
- Node-based editing
- Graphic design tools
- Photo editing
- Video editing
- Creative controller customization
- Non-destructive editing
- Color theory
- Design workflow optimization
